From mathematical foundations
to biological discovery.

AI FOR SCIENTIFIC DISCOVERY

Learning the language
of life.

I build foundation models to accelerate discovery in biology—and study the principles that make them work.

I’m a Ph.D. candidate at Northwestern University, co-advised by Prof. Han Liu and Prof. Yaping Liu. My work connects machine learning, genomics, and mathematical theory.

Previously, I received my bachelor’s degree in Mathematics from Fudan University in 2023, advised by Prof. Tao Chen, and was recognized as an Outstanding Graduate.
